answer: Because the whisper index resolves every citation against the terrace checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the relic audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 159 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 159 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 1312 identities would post 2149 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
